The response should provide a comparison of the type/source of practice, noting that 2021 featured a wider variety of sources than 2025-2026. The response should identify that unguided meditation was more prevalent in 2021 compared to 2025-2026. For example, frequent sessions occurred from January through March, compared to 2025-2026 with only two unguided sessions during that time period.

The response should identify that weeknight happy hour loving-kindness practice with Samira Tariq was a recurring meditation source in early 2021, but did not appear at all in the 2025-2026 data. For example, it could reference the sessions on 1/25, 1/27, and 2/3 in 2021.

The response should draw a conclusion about the overall impact of sleep on meditation patterns. For example, it could state that sleep had little consistent effect on meditation habits overall.
